en.t: Heraclius is crowned emperor in Constantinople
en.s: On October 5, 610, Patriarch Sergius crowned Heraclius emperor in Constantinople, following the overthrow of Phocas.
en.n: Heraclius’ fleet had landed nearby on October 3. The coronation date follows the historical chronology without conversion to the modern Gregorian calendar.

zh.t: 希拉克略在君士坦丁堡加冕
zh.s: 610年10月5日，福卡斯被推翻后，牧首塞尔吉乌斯在君士坦丁堡为希拉克略加冕，使其成为皇帝。
zh.n: 希拉克略的舰队于10月3日在附近登陆。加冕日期沿用历史记载，未换算为现代公历。

en.t: Pope Stephen IV crowns Louis the Pious at Reims
en.s: On October 5, 816, Pope Stephen IV crowned Louis the Pious as emperor at Reims. Louis had already received an imperial coronation from his father in Aachen in 813.
en.n: The date follows the historical chronology and has not been converted to the modern Gregorian calendar.

zh.t: 教皇斯德望四世在兰斯为虔诚者路易加冕
zh.s: 816年10月5日，教皇斯德望四世在兰斯为虔诚者路易举行皇帝加冕礼。路易此前已于813年在亚琛由父亲加冕为皇帝。
zh.n: 日期沿用历史记载，未换算为现代公历。

en.s: The Treaty of Zamora (Portuguese: Tratado de Zamora) was signed on 5 October 1143 between King Afonso I of Portugal and his cousin Alfonso VII of León. It took place at Zamora in the presence of the papal legate, Cardinal Guido de Vico. On the occasion, Alfonso VII acknowledged Afonso as king of Portugal.

zh.s: 1143年10月5日，葡萄牙国王阿方索一世与他的表亲、莱昂国王阿方索七世在萨莫拉签署《萨莫拉条约》，教皇使节、枢机主教圭多·德·维科出席。阿方索七世在签约时承认阿方索一世为葡萄牙国王。

en.s: The Gascon campaign of 1450–1453 took place during the Hundred Years' War when the kingdom of France undertook a military campaign to invade and cede the Duchy of Gascony from the English. Following the decisive victory of the French at the battle of Castillion and after the fall of Bordeaux, the last English stronghold in Gascony, English control of Gascony was removed.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1450年至1453年的加斯科涅战役发生于百年战争期间。法国王国发动军事行动，试图入侵并从英国手中夺取加斯科涅公国。法国军队在卡斯蒂永战役中取得决定性胜利、攻陷加斯科涅最后的英军据点波尔多后，英国失去了对加斯科涅的控制。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The siege of Riga by the Russian army under Tsar Alexei Mikhailovich was the main event of the Russo-Swedish War. The fortifications of Riga consisted of a wall with ditch and 5 bastions around the old town. In 1652 Swedes had started construction of a new wall with 12 bastions around suburbs, but by 1656 the work had not been completed.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1656年，沙皇阿列克谢·米哈伊洛维奇率领俄罗斯军队围攻里加，这是俄瑞战争的主要战事。里加的防御工事包括环绕旧城的一道城墙、护城河和5座棱堡。瑞典人于1652年开始在郊区修建一道有12座棱堡的新城墙，但到1656年尚未完工。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The siege of Haguenau took place from 27 September to 5 October 1705 during the War of the Spanish Succession. An Imperial army under Johann Karl von Thüngen captured the French town of Haguenau in Alsace.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1705年9月27日至10月5日，西班牙王位继承战争期间，帝国军队围攻并攻占了阿尔萨斯的法国城市哈格瑙。帝国军由约翰·卡尔·冯·通根指挥。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Battle of Vila Velha or Battle of Vila Velha de Ródão took place in October 1762 when a British-Portuguese force led by John Burgoyne and Charles Lee surprised and recaptured the town of Vila Velha de Ródão, Portugal, from Spanish invaders during the Seven Years' War as part of the Spanish invasion.

zh.s: 维拉韦利亚战役又称维拉韦利亚-迪罗当战役。1762年10月，约翰·伯戈因和查尔斯·李率领英葡联军突袭并夺回葡萄牙的维拉韦利亚-迪罗当镇，击退西班牙入侵者。这场战斗发生在七年战争期间，是西班牙入侵的一部分。

en.t: British forces capture French vessels in Genoa’s harbour
en.s: On October 5, 1793, a British squadron raided Genoa’s harbour and captured the French frigate Modeste and two smaller armed vessels, violating Genoese neutrality.

zh.t: 英军在热那亚港夺取法国舰船
zh.s: 1793年10月5日，一支英国舰队突袭热那亚港，夺取法国护卫舰“莫代斯特”号及两艘较小的武装船只，侵犯了热那亚的中立地位。

en.s: 13 Vendémiaire, Year 4 in the French Republican Calendar (5 October 1795 in the Gregorian calendar), was a battle between the French Revolutionary troops and Royalist forces in the streets of Paris. This battle was part of the establishing of a new form of government, the Directory, and it was a major factor in the rapid advancement of Republican General Napoleon Bonaparte's career.

zh.s: 法国共和历四年雾月十三日（公历1795年10月5日），法国革命军与保王党军队在巴黎街头交战。该战斗是建立督政府这一新政体过程中的一部分，也促使共和派将军拿破仑·波拿巴的仕途迅速上升。

en.s: The first combat of Schwanden and the second combat of Schwanden (5 October [O.S. 24 September] 1799) saw a Russian rearguard under the command of Pyotr Bagration, which acted self-determinately and not dependently on the commander-in-chief Suvorov, repelling a French attacks of Gabriel Molitor, who was directed by Honoré Gazan, at Schwanden, with various success, when the French commander-in-chief André Masséna tried to catch up with Suvorov's army.

zh.s: 第一次和第二次施万登战斗于1799年10月5日（儒略历9月24日）爆发。当时，彼得·巴格拉季昂指挥的俄罗斯后卫部队自行行动，没有依从总司令苏沃洛夫的命令，在施万登击退了加布里埃尔·莫利托率领的法军。莫利托听从奥诺雷·加赞的指挥，交战结果各有胜负；当时法国总司令安德烈·马塞纳正试图追上苏沃洛夫的军队。

en.s: The action of 5 October 1804 was fought off Cabo de Santa Maria during the Napoleonic Wars. In the engagement, a British squadron under Commodore Graham Moore attacked a Spanish squadron led by Brigadier José de Bustamante. Although Britain and Spain were at peace at the time, the British had received intelligence that Bustamante's squadron was transporting gold from Montevideo to Cádiz to bolster Spain's finances before the Spanish declared war on Britain.

zh.s: 拿破仑战争期间，1804年10月5日，英国舰队在圣玛丽亚角附近海域发动海战。格雷厄姆·摩尔准将率领的英国舰队袭击了何塞·德·布斯塔曼特准将指挥的西班牙舰队。当时英西两国处于和平状态，但英国方面得到情报，称布斯塔曼特的舰队正运送从蒙得维的亚运来的黄金前往加的斯，以加强西班牙财力，为该国向英国宣战做准备。

loc: 加拿大莫拉维恩敦特拉华族

en.s: The Battle of the Thames, also known as the Battle of Moraviantown, was a United States victory in the War of 1812 against the United Kingdom and Tecumseh's Confederacy. It took place on October 5, 1813 in Upper Canada, near present-day Chatham, Ontario. British troops under Major General Henry Procter had occupied Detroit until the U.S. Navy gained control of Lake Erie, depriving them of their supplies. Procter was forced to retreat north up the river Thames to Moraviantown, where his allies, the tribal confederacy under Shawnee leader Tecumseh, had no choice but to follow.

zh.s: 1813年10月5日，1812年战争期间，美国军队在上加拿大（今安大略省查塔姆附近）与英国和特库姆塞联盟交战并获胜。亨利·普罗克特少将率领英军，此前一直占领底特律；美国海军控制伊利湖后，英军补给被切断。普罗克特被迫沿泰晤士河向北撤至莫拉维恩敦，他的盟友——由肖尼族领袖特库姆塞领导的部族联盟——也只能跟随撤退。

en.s: The 1813 Delaware gubernatorial election was held on October 5, 1813. The Federalist former judge of the Delaware Court of Common Pleas Daniel Rodney defeated the Democratic-Republican New Castle county commissioner James Riddle.

zh.s: 1813年10月5日，特拉华州举行州长选举。联邦党候选人、特拉华州普通诉讼法院前法官丹尼尔·罗德尼击败民主共和党候选人、纽卡斯尔县专员詹姆斯·里德尔。

en.s: The 1819 Delaware gubernatorial election was held on October 5, 1819. Incumbent Federalist Governor John Clark was unable to seek re-election due to term limits. State Senator Henry Molleston ran as Clark's successor, winning the Federalist nomination. He faced Manaen Bull, Clark's 1816 opponent, and the Democratic-Republican nominee. Molleston won by a fairly wide margin, but died on November 11, 1819, prior to assuming office.

zh.s: 1819年10月5日，特拉华州举行州长选举。现任联邦党州长约翰·克拉克因任期限制不能竞选连任。州参议员亨利·莫尔斯顿赢得联邦党提名，作为克拉克的继任者参选；他的对手是民主共和党候选人马纳恩·布尔，布尔曾在1816年与克拉克竞争。莫尔斯顿以较大优势获胜，但于1819年11月11日、就职前去世。

en.s: The 1829 Georgia gubernatorial election was held on October 5, 1829, to elect the governor of Georgia. Jacksonian Troup Governor John Forsyth, first elected in the 1827 election, declined to seek re-election to a second term, instead aiming to be elected to the U.S. Senate. Jacksonian Troup candidate George Rockingham Gilmer, U.S House rep for Georgia's 1st congressional district, won in a landslide with the backing of both local parties.

zh.s: 1829年10月5日，佐治亚州举行州长选举。杰克逊派州长约翰·福赛思于1827年首次当选，但拒绝竞选连任，转而争取当选联邦参议员。杰克逊派候选人乔治·罗金厄姆·吉尔默曾任佐治亚州第一国会选区的联邦众议员，在两党地方组织支持下以压倒性优势获胜。

en.s: The 1835 Michigan gubernatorial election was held on October 5, 1835. Democratic nominee Stevens T. Mason defeated Whig nominee John Biddle with 90.31% of the vote. This was the first state election for the Governor of Michigan; in addition to electing a governor (and lieutenant governor), Michigan also elected a prospective congressman and approved a state constitution.

zh.s: 1835年10月5日，密歇根州举行州长选举。民主党候选人史蒂文斯·T·梅森以90.31%的得票率击败辉格党候选人约翰·比德尔。这是密歇根州首次州长选举；选民还选出副州长和预备国会议员，并批准了一部州宪法。

en.s: The 1835 Georgia gubernatorial election was held on October 5, 1835, to elect the governor of Georgia. Democratic Union Governor Wilson Lumpkin, first elected in the 1831 election, did not seek re-election to a second term, instead he became U.S. commissioner to the Cherokee Native Americans. Democratic Union candidate William Schley, U.S House rep for Georgia's 1st congressional district, narrowly defeated Whig State Rights candidate Charles Dougherty.

zh.s: 1835年10月5日，佐治亚州举行州长选举。民主联盟州长威尔逊·伦普金于1831年首次当选，但没有竞选连任，而是出任美国负责切罗基原住民事务的专员。民主联盟候选人威廉·施莱曾任佐治亚州第一国会选区联邦众议员，他以微弱优势击败辉格党州权派候选人查尔斯·多尔蒂。

en.t: United States House of Representatives election in Florida, 1846
en.s: The Election to the United States House of Representatives in Florida for the 30th Congress was held on October 5, 1846.

zh.t: 1846年佛罗里达州美国众议院选举
zh.s: 1846年10月5日，佛罗里达州举行美国众议院第30届国会选举。

en.t: United States House of Representatives election in Florida, 1852
en.s: The election to the United States House of Representatives in Florida for the 33rd Congress was held October 5, 1852 at the same time as the election for Governor.

zh.t: 1852年佛罗里达州美国众议院选举
zh.s: 1852年10月5日，佛罗里达州举行美国众议院第33届国会选举，与州长选举同时进行。

en.s: The Battle of Toppenish Creek was the first engagement of the Yakima War in Washington. Fought on October 5, 1855, a company of American soldiers, under Major Granville O. Haller, was attacked by a band of Yakamas, under Chief Kamiakin, and compelled to retreat. The battle occurred in Yakima Valley, several miles northwest of Fort Walla Walla, along Toppenish Creek and was a major victory for Native American forces.

zh.s: 1855年10月5日，雅基马战争的首场交战在华盛顿州发生。格兰维尔·O·哈勒少校率领一支美军连队，在托珀尼什溪沿岸、沃拉沃拉堡西北数英里处遭到卡米亚金酋长率领的一支雅基马人队伍袭击，被迫撤退。此战是原住民军队的一场重大胜利。

en.t: Joseph E. Brown wins Georgia’s 1857 gubernatorial election
en.s: On October 5, 1857, Georgia held its gubernatorial election. Democrat Joseph E. Brown defeated Know Nothing candidate Benjamin H. Hill.

zh.t: 约瑟夫·布朗赢得1857年佐治亚州州长选举
zh.s: 1857年10月5日，美国佐治亚州举行州长选举。民主党人约瑟夫·布朗击败一无所知党候选人本杰明·希尔。

en.s: The 1857 Mississippi gubernatorial election was held on October 5, 1857, in order to elect the Governor of Mississippi. Former Democratic member of the U.S. House of Representatives from Mississippi's 3rd district William McWillie defeated the American Party nominee Edward M. Yerger.

zh.s: 1857年10月5日，密西西比州举行州长选举。民主党候选人、前美国众议院密西西比州第三选区议员威廉·麦克威利击败美国党候选人爱德华·M·耶格。

en.s: The Battle of Cockle Creek, October 5, 1861, was a minor naval engagement off Chincoteague, Virginia early in the American Civil War.

zh.s: 1861年10月5日，美国内战初期，弗吉尼亚州钦科蒂格附近海域发生了一场小规模海战。

en.t: Union forces win the Battle of Hatchie Bridge
en.s: On October 5, 1862, Union forces pushed part of Earl Van Dorn’s retreating Confederate army back across the Hatchie River at Davis Bridge in Tennessee. Van Dorn found another crossing and escaped with his army.
en.n: This engagement followed the Confederate defeat at Corinth on October 4.

zh.t: 联邦军赢得哈奇桥战斗
zh.s: 1862年10月5日，联邦军在田纳西州戴维斯桥将厄尔·范多恩率领的部分邦联军击退至哈奇河对岸。范多恩找到另一处渡口，带领军队脱身。
zh.n: 这场交战发生在邦联军10月4日于科林斯战败之后。

en.s: The 1863 Georgia gubernatorial election was held on October 5, 1863, in order to elect the Governor of Georgia. It was the last gubernatorial election in Georgia under the Confederate States of America and saw Independent Democrat nominee and incumbent Governor Joseph E. Brown win a fourth and final term against Unionist nominee Joshua Hill and Pro-Administration nominee Lt. Col Timothy Furlow.

zh.s: 1863年10月5日，佐治亚州举行州长选举。这是该州在美利坚联盟国时期举行的最后一次州长选举。独立民主党候选人、现任州长约瑟夫·E·布朗赢得第四个也是最后一个任期，对手为联邦主义者候选人约书亚·希尔和亲政府候选人蒂莫西·弗洛中校。

en.s: The 1863 Mississippi gubernatorial election was held on October 5, 1863, to elect the governor of Mississippi. Charles Clark, a Democrat, won against Democrat A. M. West and Fire-Eater Democrat Reuben Davis.

zh.s: 1863年10月5日，密西西比州举行州长选举。民主党人查尔斯·克拉克击败民主党人A·M·韦斯特和“火食派”民主党人鲁本·戴维斯，当选州长。

en.s: The attack on USS New Ironsides in October 1863 was one of the first successful torpedo boat engagements in history. Confederate forces in Charleston, South Carolina deployed the newly built semi-submersible CSS David to attach a spar torpedo to the hull of USS New Ironsides. Though the attack is regarded as a rebel victory, the Union ship was saved from serious damage.

zh.s: 1863年10月，美国内战期间，南方邦联军队在南卡罗来纳州查尔斯顿派出新建的半潜式“戴维号”舰艇，试图用杆式鱼雷击中联邦海军“新铁甲号”舰的船体。这是历史上最早取得成功的鱼雷艇交战行动之一。虽然这次袭击被视为叛军获胜，但联邦军舰没有受到严重损坏。

en.s: The Battle of Allatoona, also known as the Battle of Allatoona Pass, was fought October 5, 1864, in Bartow County, Georgia, and was the first major engagement of the Franklin-Nashville Campaign of the American Civil War. A Confederate division under Maj. Gen. Samuel G. French attacked a Union garrison under Brig. Gen. John M. Corse, but was unable to dislodge it from its fortified position protecting the railroad through Allatoona Pass.

zh.s: 1864年10月5日，美国内战期间，富兰克林—纳什维尔战役的首场重大战役在佐治亚州巴托县爆发。塞缪尔·G·弗伦奇少将指挥的南方邦联军一个师进攻约翰·M·科尔斯准将率领的联邦军驻军，但未能将其从坚固阵地上赶走；联邦军驻守该阵地，以保护阿拉图纳隘口的铁路。

en.t: The Eastman Tunnel collapses beneath Saint Anthony Falls
en.s: On October 5, 1869, the Mississippi River broke through the roof of the Eastman Tunnel beneath Saint Anthony Falls in Minnesota. The collapse threatened to destroy the falls.
en.n: Water had begun leaking into the tunnel on October 4; the major breach and collapse followed on October 5.

zh.t: 圣安东尼瀑布下方的伊士曼隧道坍塌
zh.s: 1869年10月5日，密西西比河水冲破明尼苏达州圣安东尼瀑布下方伊士曼隧道的顶部，引发坍塌，瀑布也面临被冲毁的危险。
zh.n: 隧道在10月4日已开始渗水，大规模决口和坍塌发生在次日。

en.s: The Nez Perce War was an armed conflict in 1877 in the Western United States that pitted several bands of the Nez Perce tribe of Native Americans and their allies, a small band of the Palouse tribe led by Red Echo (Hahtalekin) and Bald Head (Husishusis Kute), against the United States Army.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1877年，美国西部发生内兹珀斯战争，交战双方是数支内兹珀斯部族及其盟友——由红回声（Hahtalekin）和秃头（Husishusis Kute）领导的一支帕卢斯部族，以及美国陆军。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.t: Chief Joseph lays down arms at Bear Paw
en.s: On October 5, 1877, Nez Perce leader Chief Joseph laid down his rifle at Bear Paw in Montana after a five-day battle and siege. White Bird refused to surrender and left with others that night.
en.n: The surrender did not include all Nez Perce people at Bear Paw.

zh.t: 约瑟夫酋长在熊掌山放下武器
zh.s: 1877年10月5日，经过五天的战斗和围困，内兹珀斯族领袖约瑟夫酋长在蒙大拿的熊掌山交出步枪。“白鸟”拒绝投降，当晚带领其他人离开。
zh.n: 并非熊掌山所有内兹珀斯人都参加了投降。

en.s: The Kresna–Razlog uprising (Bulgarian: Кресненско-Разложко въстание, romanized: Kresnensko-Razlozhko vastanie), also known as the Kresna uprising (Macedonian: Кресненско востание, romanized: Kresnensko vostanie), was an anti-Ottoman Bulgarian uprising that took place in Ottoman Macedonia, predominantly in the areas of modern Blagoevgrad Province in Bulgaria in late 1878 and early 1879. It was named by the insurgents as the Macedonian uprising.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.t: 克雷斯纳—拉兹洛格起义
zh.s: 克雷斯纳—拉兹洛格起义（保加利亚语：Кресненско-Разложко въстание，转写：Kresnensko-Razlozhko vastanie）又称克雷斯纳起义（马其顿语：Кресненско востание，转写：Kresnensko vostanie），是保加利亚人反抗奥斯曼帝国的起义，发生于1878年末至1879年初，地点在奥斯曼统治下的马其顿，主要位于今保加利亚布拉戈耶夫格勒州一带。起义者称其为“马其顿起义”。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件开始日期。

en.t: Merritt’s reinforcements reach U.S. troops at Milk Creek
en.s: On October 5, 1879, reinforcements led by Colonel Wesley Merritt reached U.S. troops at Milk Creek in Colorado. The Ute fighters had already dispersed by the time he arrived.
en.n: This records the reinforcements’ arrival, rather than every event in the White River conflict.

zh.t: 梅里特率援军抵达米尔克溪
zh.s: 1879年10月5日，韦斯利·梅里特上校率援军抵达科罗拉多的米尔克溪，与当地美军会合。他抵达前，尤特族战士已经散去。
zh.n: 这里记录的是援军抵达，并非白河冲突所有事件的日期。

en.s: Bering Sea Anti-Poaching Operations were conducted in 1891 by the navies and marine corps' of the United States and the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland. Due to the near extinction of the seal population in the Bering Sea, the American and British governments dispatched a squadron of warships to suppress poaching activities, under the command of United States Navy Commander Charles S. Cotton.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1891年，美国和大不列颠及爱尔兰联合王国的海军及海军陆战队在白令海开展反偷猎行动。由于当地海豹数量濒临灭绝，美国和英国政府派遣舰队制止偷猎活动，由美国海军司令查尔斯·S·科顿指挥。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The 1892 Georgia gubernatorial election was held on October 5, 1892, in order to elect the Governor of Georgia. Democratic nominee and incumbent Governor William J. Northen defeated People's Party nominee W. L. Peck.

zh.s: 1892年10月5日，佐治亚州举行州长选举。民主党候选人、现任州长威廉·J·诺森击败人民党候选人W·L·佩克。

en.t: The final resistance at Canudos is defeated
en.s: On October 5, 1897, Brazilian forces defeated the remaining defenders of Canudos in Bahia, bringing the War of Canudos to an end.
en.n: The settlement was burned the following day, October 6.

zh.t: 卡努杜斯最后的抵抗力量被击败
zh.s: 1897年10月5日，巴西军队击败巴伊亚州卡努杜斯最后的守军，卡努杜斯战争至此结束。
zh.n: 聚落于次日，即10月6日被焚毁。

en.s: The Battle of Sugar Point, or the Battle of Leech Lake, was fought on October 5, 1898 between the 3rd U.S. Infantry and members of the Pillager Band of Chippewa Indians in a failed attempt to apprehend Pillager Ojibwe Bugonaygeshig ("Old Bug" or "Hole-In-The-Day"), as the result of a dispute with Indian Service officials on the Leech Lake Reservation in Cass County, Minnesota. Often referred to as "the last Indian Uprising in the United States", the engagement was also the first battle to be fought in the area of the United States known as the Old Northwest since the Black Hawk War in 1832.

zh.s: 舒格角战役又称利奇湖战役，于1898年10月5日爆发。美国第3步兵团试图抓捕奇佩瓦族掠夺者部落成员布戈奈格希希（“老布格”或“日中天”），原因是他与利奇湖保留地的印第安事务官员发生争执。交战发生在明尼苏达州卡斯县。该战常被称为“美国最后一次印第安人起义”，也是1832年黑鹰战争以来，美国旧西北地区的首场战斗。

en.s: The 1898 Georgia gubernatorial election was held on October 5, 1898, in order to elect the Governor of Georgia. Democratic nominee and incumbent Secretary of State of Georgia Allen D. Candler defeated People's Party nominee John R. Hogan.

zh.s: 1898年10月5日，佐治亚州举行州长选举。民主党候选人、佐治亚州现任国务卿艾伦·D·坎德勒击败人民党候选人约翰·R·霍根。

en.s: The 1904 Georgia gubernatorial election was held on October 5, 1904, in order to elect the Governor of Georgia. Democratic nominee and incumbent Governor Joseph M. Terrell ran unopposed and thus won re-election.

zh.s: 1904年10月5日，佐治亚州举行州长选举。民主党候选人、现任州长约瑟夫·M·特雷尔没有对手，因而成功连任。

en.s: On October 5, 1908, in the Gregorian calendar, Prince Ferdinand proclaimed Bulgaria’s independence from the Ottoman Empire at Tarnovo.
en.n: The same date was September 22, 1908, in the Julian calendar then used in Bulgaria.

zh.t: 斐迪南宣布保加利亚独立
zh.s: 1908年10月5日，斐迪南亲王在特尔诺沃宣布保加利亚脱离奥斯曼帝国独立。
zh.n: 这里采用公历日期；按当时保加利亚使用的儒略历，这一天是1908年9月22日。

en.s: On October 5, 1910, a republic was proclaimed in Lisbon after the overthrow of Portugal’s monarchy.
en.n: The proclamation preceded the adoption of the new constitution in 1911.

zh.t: 葡萄牙宣布成立共和国
zh.s: 1910年10月5日，葡萄牙君主制被推翻后，共和国在里斯本宣告成立。
zh.n: 新宪法于1911年通过，晚于共和国成立宣言。

en.s: The 1910 Georgia gubernatorial election was held on October 5, 1910, in order to elect the Governor of Georgia. Democratic nominee and former Governor Hoke Smith defeated Independent Democratic candidate and incumbent Governor Joseph Mackey Brown and Socialist Party nominee C. O. Brown.

zh.s: 1910年10月5日，佐治亚州举行州长选举。民主党候选人、前州长霍克·史密斯击败独立民主党候选人、现任州长约瑟夫·麦基·布朗，以及社会党候选人C·O·布朗。

en.t: A French aircrew shoots down a German aircraft with machine-gun fire
en.s: On October 5, 1914, a French crew flying a Voisin III shot down a German Aviatik near Reims, France, using a machine gun.

zh.t: 法国机组用机枪击落德国飞机
zh.s: 1914年10月5日，法国机组驾驶瓦赞III型飞机，在法国兰斯附近用机枪击落一架德国阿维亚蒂克飞机。

en.t: German forces establish a foothold on the Lorette plateau
en.s: During the night of October 4–5, 1914, troops of the German Sixth Army established a foothold on the Lorette plateau in northern France.
en.n: This records the overnight advance, rather than all the later battles fought around Lorette.

zh.t: 德军在洛雷特高地建立据点
zh.s: 1914年10月4日至5日夜间，德国第六集团军在法国北部的洛雷特高地建立据点。
zh.n: 这里记录的是这次夜间推进，并非后来围绕洛雷特展开的所有战斗。

en.t: British and French troops begin landing at Salonika
en.s: On October 5, 1915, British and French troops began landing at Salonika, now Thessaloniki, in Greece.

zh.t: 英法军队开始在萨洛尼卡登陆
zh.s: 1915年10月5日，英国和法国军队开始在希腊萨洛尼卡港登陆。萨洛尼卡即今天的塞萨洛尼基。

en.s: The Third Battle of Petrozsény was a World War I military engagement between Romanian forces on one side and Central Powers forces (Austria-Hungary and Germany) on the other side. It was part of the wider Battle of Transylvania and the last engagement in the area around Petrozsény. The battle resulted in a Central Powers victory.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.t: 第三次佩特罗沙尼战役
zh.s: 第一次世界大战期间，罗马尼亚军队与奥匈帝国、德国组成的中央同盟国军队在佩特罗沙尼地区交战。此战是特兰西瓦尼亚战役的一部分，也是该地区的最后一场战斗，最终由中央同盟国获胜。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The 1923 Chinese presidential election was the election held on 5 October 1923 in Beijing for the third term of the President of China. Zhili warlord Cao Kun won the election through bribery. The capital was under control of the Zhili Clique after the Zhili–Anhui War. In 1922 the Zhili warlords Wu Peifu and Cao Kun restored the "old" parliament elected in 1912.

zh.s: 1923年10月5日，北京举行总统选举，选出中华民国总统第三任期人选。直系军阀曹锟通过贿赂赢得选举。直皖战争后，首都由直系控制。1922年，直系军阀吴佩孚和曹锟恢复了1912年选出的“旧国会”。

en.s: The 1925 FA Charity Shield was the twelfth staging of the FA Charity Shield, an annual association football match arranged to raise funds for charitable causes supported by the Football Association (the FA), the governing body of football in England. For the fourth time, the match was contested by select teams of amateur and professional players. It was played on 5 October 1925 at White Hart Lane, London, and ended as a 6–1 win for the Amateurs. Claude Ashton scored four goals and Frank Macey two for the Amateurs; Charlie Hannaford scored the Professionals' goal.

zh.s: 1925年英格兰足总慈善盾杯是该赛事第12届比赛。这项年度足球比赛由英格兰足球总会组织，为其支持的慈善事业筹款。这是业余和职业球员混合选拔队第四次参赛。比赛于1925年10月5日在伦敦白鹿巷球场举行，业余队以6比1获胜。克劳德·阿什顿为业余队打入4球，弗兰克·梅西打入2球；职业队由查理·汉纳福德攻入一球。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 1925 Hama uprising was one of the major events of the Great Syrian Revolt. It involved a rebel assault led by Fawzi al-Qawuqji against Mandatory French security installations in Hama and a subsequent uprising by residents sympathetic to the rebel cause. Heavy French bombardment of the city and the dispatch of reinforcements followed.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1925年哈马起义是叙利亚大起义中的重大事件之一。法齐·卡乌克吉率领起义军袭击法国委任统治当局在哈马的安全设施，随后同情起义的居民也发动起义。法国军队猛烈轰炸该市，并派出增援部队。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The 1926 Arkansas gubernatorial election was held on October 5, 1926. Incumbent Democratic Governor Tom Terral was defeated in the Democratic primary. Democratic nominee John Ellis Martineau defeated Republican nominee Drew Bowers with 76.45% of the vote.

zh.s: 1926年10月5日，阿肯色州举行州长选举。民主党籍现任州长汤姆·特拉尔在民主党初选中落败。民主党候选人约翰·埃利斯·马蒂诺以76.45%的得票率击败共和党候选人德鲁·鲍尔斯。

en.t: British airship R101 crashes in France
en.s: On October 5, 1930, the British airship R101 crashed near Allonne, France, during its first overseas voyage to India. Forty-eight of the 54 people aboard died.
en.n: The airship had left Britain the previous evening.

zh.s: 1930年10月5日，英国飞艇R101在首次飞往印度的海外航程中，于法国阿洛讷附近坠毁。机上54人中有48人遇难。
zh.n: 飞艇于前一天傍晚离开英国。

en.s: A military offensive was launched by Chetnik forces in 1943 to seize large territories in eastern Bosnia following the capitulation of Italy. The attack on Višegrad during this offensive was one of the few conflicts of Mihailović's Yugoslav army in the homeland with the Wehrmacht forces in the NDH area. The Chetnik attack on the German-Ustaša garrison in Višegrad on October 5, 1943 was carried out at the request of the Allies, with the aim of showing the Chetnik struggle against the occupiers to the American and British military missions.

zh.t: 1943年切特尼克军队在波斯尼亚东部的攻势
zh.s: 1943年意大利投降后，切特尼克军队发动攻势，试图夺取波斯尼亚东部大片地区。进攻维舍格勒是米哈伊洛维奇领导的祖国南斯拉夫军与NDH地区德军交战的少数行动之一。1943年10月5日，切特尼克军队根据盟军请求，袭击驻守维舍格勒的德国—乌斯塔沙联军，目的是向美国和英国军事代表团展示切特尼克部队抗击占领者的情况。

en.t: Truman gives the first televised address from the White House
en.s: On October 5, 1947, President Harry S. Truman gave the first televised address from the White House, asking viewers to conserve food for Europe.
en.n: This records a White House television address; the source does not identify the Oval Office as its setting.

zh.t: 杜鲁门首次从白宫发表电视讲话
zh.s: 1947年10月5日，美国总统哈里·杜鲁门首次从白宫发表电视讲话，呼吁观众节约粮食，援助欧洲。
zh.n: 这里记录从白宫发表的电视讲话；来源没有确认讲话地点是椭圆形办公室。

en.s: The Taiyuan campaign was a campaign of the Chinese Civil War fought between the nationalist and communist factions. The campaign was over the control of Taiyuan, the capital of the province of Shanxi, China. The campaign resulted in a communist victory.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 太原战役是中国内战期间国民党与共产党的军事战役，双方争夺中国山西省省会太原。战役最终以共产党获胜告终。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件开始日期。

en.s: The 1960 DFB-Pokal final decided the winner of the 1959–60 DFB-Pokal, the 17th season of Germany's knockout football cup competition. It was played on 5 October 1960 at the Rheinstadion in Düsseldorf. Borussia München Gladbach won the match 3–2 against Karlsruher SC, to claim their first cup title.

zh.s: 1960年德国足协杯决赛决出了1959—1960赛季德国足协杯冠军，这是该项德国淘汰赛制杯赛的第17个赛季。比赛于1960年10月5日在杜塞尔多夫莱茵体育场举行。门兴格拉德巴赫队以3比2击败卡尔斯鲁厄队，首次夺得德国杯冠军。

en.s: On October 5, 1962, Dr. No, the first film in the James Bond series, premiered in London.
en.n: This records the London premiere; the wider British release followed.

zh.s: 1962年10月5日，詹姆斯·邦德系列的首部电影《007之诺博士》在伦敦首映。
zh.n: 这里记录伦敦首映，英国其他地区随后上映。

en.t: Kennedy reviews aid restrictions on South Vietnam
en.s: On October 5, 1963, President John F. Kennedy and his advisers met at the White House to review aid restrictions on South Vietnam, including funding for the Commercial Import Program that had already been suspended.
en.n: October 5 is the date of this discussion, rather than the first suspension of import funding.

zh.t: 肯尼迪讨论对南越的援助限制
zh.s: 1963年10月5日，约翰·肯尼迪总统与顾问在白宫讨论对南越的援助限制，包括此前已暂停拨款的商业进口项目。
zh.n: 10月5日是这次讨论的日期，并非进口资金首次暂停的日期。

en.s: The 1965 Greater Anchorage Borough election was an election for borough offices in Anchorage, Alaska. It was held on October 5, 1965. 8,535 ballots were cast. In a proposition ("Prop B"), the borough's voters voted overwhelmingly against reclassifying from a second class borough into a first class borough, maintaining the borough classification that they had voted to adopt two years prior.

zh.s: 1965年10月5日，阿拉斯加大安克雷奇自治市举行市政官员选举，共投出8535张选票。在一项名为“提案B”的公投中，选民以压倒性多数反对将自治市从二级改为一级，维持两年前投票决定采用的二级自治市级别。

en.s: The Korean DMZ Conflict, also known as the Second Korean War, was a series of armed clashes between North Korea and South Korea, supported by the United States, along the Korean Demilitarized Zone (DMZ) between 1966 and 1969.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 朝韩非军事区冲突又称第二次朝鲜战争，是1966年至1969年间，朝鲜与得到美国支持的韩国沿朝鲜非军事区发生的一系列武装冲突。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件开始日期。

en.t: The FLQ kidnaps James Cross in Montreal
en.s: On October 5, 1970, members of the Front de libération du Québec kidnapped British trade commissioner James Cross from his home in Montreal, beginning the October Crisis.
en.n: Pierre Laporte was kidnapped separately on October 10.

zh.t: 魁北克解放阵线在蒙特利尔绑架詹姆斯·克罗斯
zh.s: 1970年10月5日，魁北克解放阵线成员在蒙特利尔的家中绑架英国贸易专员詹姆斯·克罗斯，十月危机由此开始。
zh.n: 皮埃尔·拉波尔特是在10月10日另一起事件中遭绑架的。

en.s: The Provisional Irish Republican Army (IRA) detonated two 6-pound (2.7-kilogram) gelignite bombs at two pubs in Guildford, Surrey, England on 5 October 1974. The pubs were targeted that evening because they were popular with British Army personnel stationed at Pirbright barracks. Four soldiers and one civilian were killed. Sixty-five people were wounded.

zh.s: 1974年10月5日，爱尔兰共和军（IRA）在英格兰萨里郡吉尔福德的两家酒吧引爆了两枚6磅（2.7公斤）重的硝化甘油炸弹。袭击发生在当晚，因为两家酒吧深受驻扎在皮尔布赖特军营的英国陆军人员欢迎。爆炸造成4名士兵和1名平民死亡，65人受伤。

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Austria on 5 October 1975. The result was a victory for the Social Democratic Party, which won 93 of the 183 seats. Voter turnout was 92.9%.

zh.s: 1975年10月5日，奥地利举行议会选举。社会民主党获胜，赢得183席中的93席。投票率为92.9%。

en.s: Operación Primicia (Spanish pronunciation: [opeɾaˈsjon pɾiˈmisja], "Operation Scoop") was a large guerrilla attack that took place on 5 October 1975, in Formosa, Argentina. It was the largest attack ever launched by the paramilitary group Montoneros, which attempted to seize the barracks of the 29th Forest infantry regiment. This attack worsened the Dirty War, and indirectly led to the 1976 Argentine coup d'état the following year.

zh.s: “初霜行动”（西班牙语：Operación Primicia，发音：[opeɾaˈsjon pɾiˈmisja]，意为“突袭行动”）是1975年10月5日在阿根廷福尔摩萨发生的一次大规模游击队袭击。蒙托内罗斯组织试图夺取第29丛林步兵团营房，这是该组织发动过的最大规模袭击。这次袭击使肮脏战争局势恶化，并间接导致阿根廷次年发生1976年政变。

en.s: A federal election was held in West Germany on 5 October 1980 to elect the members of the 9th Bundestag. Although the CDU/CSU remained the largest faction in parliament, Helmut Schmidt of the Social Democratic Party remained Chancellor.

zh.s: 1980年10月5日，西德举行联邦选举，选出第9届联邦议院议员。尽管基民盟/基社盟仍是议会第一大党团，社会民主党籍赫尔穆特·施密特继续担任总理。

en.s: The 1980 Portuguese legislative election took place on 5 October. The election renewed all 250 members of the Assembly of the Republic. Following the victory of the Democratic Alliance (AD) in the previous election, on 2 December 1979, Francisco Sá Carneiro was sworn in as Prime Minister in January 1980.

zh.s: 1980年10月5日，葡萄牙举行议会选举，改选共和国议会全部250名议员。民主联盟在此前的1979年12月2日选举中获胜后，弗朗西斯科·萨·卡内罗于1980年1月宣誓就任总理。

en.s: The Ras Burqa massacre was a mass shooting on 5 October 1985 on Israeli vacationers in Ras Burqa, a beach resort area in the Sinai peninsula, in which seven people, including four children, were killed by Egyptian soldier Suleiman Khater.

zh.s: 1985年10月5日，埃及士兵苏莱曼·哈特尔在西奈半岛拉斯布尔卡海滨度假区向以色列游客开枪，造成7人死亡，其中包括4名儿童。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Egypt on 5 October 1987. The vote took the form of a referendum on the candidacy of Hosni Mubarak, who had been nominated by the two-thirds required in the People's Assembly on 5 July. Just over 97% of voters allegedly voted in favour with an 88.5% turnout.

zh.s: 1987年10月5日，埃及举行总统选举，以公投形式确认侯斯尼·穆巴拉克的候选资格。人民议会于7月5日提名他，提名获得超过法定三分之二多数。选民中略高于97%的人据称投票支持穆巴拉克，投票率为88.5%。

en.s: A national plebiscite was held in Chile on 5 October 1988 to decide whether Augusto Pinochet, the head of a military dictatorship that had ruled the country since the 1973 coup d'état, would remain president for a further eight-year term. Voters were asked simply to approve or reject Pinochet as the sole candidate proposed by the commanders-in-chief of the armed forces, a mechanism set out in the transitory provisions of the 1980 Constitution.

zh.s: 1988年10月5日，智利举行全国公投，决定自1973年政变以来统治该国的军事独裁者奥古斯托·皮诺切特是否继续担任总统，再任8年。选民只需投票赞成或反对武装部队总司令提名的唯一候选人皮诺切特。这一机制载于1980年宪法的过渡条款。

en.s: The Herald was a morning and, later, evening broadsheet newspaper published in Melbourne, Australia, from 3 January 1840 to 5 October 1990. It later merged with its sister morning newspaper The Sun News-Pictorial to form the Herald-Sun.

zh.s: 《先驱报》是一份在澳大利亚墨尔本出版的早报，后来改为晚报，报纸形式为大开本，发行时间为1840年1月3日至1990年10月5日。之后，该报与姊妹晨报《太阳新闻画报》合并，成为《先驱太阳报》。

zh.s: 1991年10月5日，一架印度尼西亚空军洛克希德C-130H-30“大力神”运输机从雅加达哈利姆·珀达纳库苏马机场起飞后不久，因发动机起火而坠毁。机上134人中除1人外全部遇难，地面另有2人死亡。

en.s: The Battle of Zadar (Croatian: Bitka za Zadar) was a military engagement between the Yugoslav People's Army (Jugoslovenska Narodna Armija, or JNA), supported by the Croatian Serb Serbian Autonomous Oblast of Krajina (SAO Krajina), and the Croatian National Guard (Zbor Narodne Garde, or ZNG), supported by the Croatian Police. The battle was fought north and east of the city of Zadar, Croatia, in the second half of September and early October 1991 during the Croatian War of Independence.

zh.s: 扎达尔战役（克罗地亚语：Bitka za Zadar）是南斯拉夫人民军与克罗地亚国民卫队之间的军事交战。南斯拉夫人民军得到克拉伊纳塞族自治区支持，克罗地亚国民卫队则得到克罗地亚警方支持。1991年9月下半月至10月初，克罗地亚独立战争期间，战斗发生在克罗地亚扎达尔市以北和以东地区。

en.s: General elections were held in Guyana on 5 October 1992. They were the first free and fair elections since 1964. The People's Progressive Party ended the People's National Congress' 28-year rule, winning 28 of the 53 seats and 53.5% of the vote. Voter turnout was 80.4%.

zh.s: 1992年10月5日，圭亚那举行大选，是1964年以来首次自由且公平的选举。人民进步党结束了人民全国大会党长达28年的执政，赢得53席中的28席和53.5%的选票。投票率为80.4%。

en.t: Police discover 48 Solar Temple bodies in Switzerland
en.s: On October 5, 1994, police discovered 48 bodies linked to the Order of the Solar Temple at Cheiry and Granges-sur-Salvan in Switzerland.
en.n: This is the date of discovery, rather than a claim that all the victims died that day.

zh.t: 警方在瑞士发现48具与太阳圣殿教有关的遗体
zh.s: 1994年10月5日，警方在瑞士谢里和格朗日叙萨尔旺发现48具与太阳圣殿教有关的遗体。
zh.n: 这里记录的是发现遗体的日期，并非所有遇难者都在这一天死亡。

en.s: Ultimate Jeopardy - the second Ultimate Jeopardy professional wrestling supercard event produced by Extreme Championship Wrestling (ECW) - took place on October 5, 1996 in the ECW Arena in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania in the United States. Excerpts from Ultimate Jeopardy aired on episodes #181, #182, and #183 of the syndicated television program ECW Hardcore TV in October 1996, while the bout between Bam Bam Bigelow and Terry Gordy was included on the compilation DVD Extreme Warfare Volume 2.

zh.s: 《终极危机》是极限冠军摔角（ECW）举办的第二场同名职业摔角超级赛事，于1996年10月5日在美国宾夕法尼亚州费城的ECW竞技场举行。赛事片段于1996年10月在联合播出的电视节目《ECW硬核电视》第181、182和183集中播出；班·班·比格罗对阵特里·戈迪的比赛则收录在合辑DVD《极限战争》第2卷中。

en.s: Badd Blood: In Your House was the eighteenth In Your House professional wrestling pay-per-view event produced by the World Wrestling Federation and presented by PlayStation, that took place on October 5, 1997, at the Kiel Center in St. Louis, Missouri. On the afternoon of the event, Brian Pillman, who was scheduled to face Dude Love on the show, was found dead in his hotel room. The announcement was made to fans during the half-hour "pregame show" prior to the pay-per-view being broadcast.

zh.s: 《坏血：在你的房子里》是世界摔角联合会举办并由PlayStation赞助的第18场“在你的房子里”职业摔角付费电视赛事，于1997年10月5日在密苏里州圣路易斯的基尔中心举行。赛事当天午后，原定参赛、将对阵杜德·洛夫的布莱恩·皮尔曼被发现死于酒店房间。赛事开始前半小时的预热节目向观众宣布了这一消息。

en.s: The Ladbroke Grove rail crash (also known as the Paddington train crash) was a rail accident which occurred on 5 October 1999 at Ladbroke Grove in London, United Kingdom. With 31 people killed and more than 520 injured, this remains the worst rail accident on the Great Western Main Line. This was the second major accident on the Great Western Main Line in just over two years, the first being the Southall rail crash of September 1997, a few miles west of this accident. Both crashes would have been prevented by an operational Automatic Train Protection (ATP) system, wider fitting of which had been rejected on cost grounds.

zh.t: 拉德布罗克格罗夫列车相撞事故
zh.s: 拉德布罗克格罗夫列车相撞事故又称帕丁顿列车相撞事故，于1999年10月5日在英国伦敦拉德布罗克格罗夫发生。事故造成31人死亡、520多人受伤，至今仍是大西部干线最严重的铁路事故。这是两年多来该干线发生的第二起重大事故；此前，西边数英里处于1997年9月发生了索斯霍尔列车相撞事故。如果当时启用了自动列车保护（ATP）系统，两起事故本可避免；但由于成本原因，扩大系统安装范围的提议被否决。

en.s: The 1999 Des Moines mayoral election was held on October 5, 1999, to elect the mayor of Des Moines, Iowa. It saw Preston Daniels win reelection.

zh.s: 1999年10月5日，爱荷华州得梅因举行市长选举，普雷斯顿·丹尼尔斯成功连任。

en.s: The overthrow of Slobodan Milošević occurred on 5 October 2000, in Belgrade, in the Federal Republic of Yugoslavia, following the presidential election on September 24th, and culminating in the downfall of Slobodan Milošević's government on 5 October 2000.

zh.t: 推翻斯洛博丹·米洛舍维奇政权
zh.s: 2000年10月5日，南斯拉夫联盟共和国首都贝尔格莱德发生推翻斯洛博丹·米洛舍维奇政权的事件。此前，9月24日举行总统选举；10月5日，米洛舍维奇政府垮台。

en.s: The Leyenda de Plata (2001) was professional wrestling tournament produced by the Mexican wrestling promotion Consejo Mundial de Lucha Libre (CMLLl; Spanish "World Wrestling Council") that ran from October 5, 2001, over the course of three of CMLL's Friday night shows in Arena México with the finals on October 19, 2001. The annual Leyenda de Plata tournament is held in honor of lucha libre legend El Santo and is one of CMLL's most important annual tournaments.

zh.s: 2001年“白银传奇”是墨西哥摔角联盟世界摔角理事会（CMLL）主办的职业摔角锦标赛。赛事从2001年10月5日开始，在墨西哥竞技场举行，跨越CMLL的三个周五晚间节目，决赛于10月19日进行。一年一度的“白银传奇”锦标赛旨在纪念墨西哥摔角传奇人物圣徒，是CMLL最重要的年度赛事之一。

en.s: General elections were held in Bosnia and Herzegovina on 5 October 2002. The elections for the House of Representatives elections were divided into two; one for the Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina and one for Republika Srpska. In the presidential election, each of the three national communities elected a President. Bosniaks elected Sulejman Tihić, Croats elected Dragan Čović and Serbs elected Mirko Šarović.

zh.s: 2002年10月5日，波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那举行大选。众议院选举分为两部分，分别在波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那联邦和塞族共和国举行。总统选举中，三个民族社群各自选出一名总统。波什尼亚克族选出苏莱曼·蒂希奇，克罗地亚族选出德拉甘·乔维奇，塞族选出米尔科·沙罗维奇。

en.s: The 2002 Shreveport mayoral election resulted in the re-election of Democrat Keith Hightower who defeated Republican Vernon Adams by a large margin in the election of October 5, 2002. As Hightower won a simple majority in this round, no run-off election was held.

zh.s: 2002年10月5日，什里夫波特举行市长选举。民主党籍基思·海托尔以较大优势击败共和党候选人弗农·亚当斯，成功连任。海托尔在首轮投票中获得简单多数，因此没有举行决选。

en.s: General elections were held in Republika Srpska on 5 October 2002, as part of the general elections across Bosnia and Herzegovina. Dragan Čavić of the Serb Democratic Party was elected president. As of 2025, This was the most recent Presidential election that the Serb Democratic Party or any other party other then Alliance of Independent Social Democrats won.

zh.s: 2002年10月5日，塞族共和国举行大选，这是波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那全国大选的一部分。塞族民主党候选人德拉甘·恰维奇当选总统。截至2025年，这是塞族民主党或其他政党（独立社会民主人士联盟除外）最近一次赢得总统选举。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in the disputed Russian republic of Chechnya on 5 October 2003, amidst the Second Chechen War. Held six months after a three-part constitutional referendum, the election was reported as a success for Russian-backed candidate Akhmad Kadyrov, who reportedly won with 84% of the vote and 88% turnout. Early candidates in the election besides Kadyrov included Aslambek Aslakhanov, Malik Saidullaev, and Umar Dzhabrailov.

zh.s: 2003年10月5日，第二次车臣战争期间，有争议的俄罗斯自治共和国车臣举行总统选举。此前6个月，当地举行了分为三部分的宪法公投。据报道，得到俄罗斯支持的候选人艾哈迈德·卡德罗夫以84%的得票率和88%的投票率获胜。卡德罗夫以外的早期候选人包括阿斯兰别克·阿斯拉哈诺夫、马利克·赛杜拉耶夫和乌马尔·贾布拉伊洛夫。

en.t: 2003 All-Ireland Senior Ladies' Football Championship final
en.s: The 2003 TG4 All-Ireland Senior Ladies' Football Championship Final featured Mayo and Dublin. Mayo defeated Dublin in a low scoring game. Mayo retained the title, winning their fourth final in five years, while Dublin were making their debut appearance. Dublin led 0–4 to 0–2 at half-time. Two minutes from full-time Mayo trailed Dublin by a point. However the match was decided thanks to a late goal from Player of the Match, Diane O'Hora.

zh.t: 2003年全爱尔兰高级女子盖尔式足球锦标赛决赛
zh.s: 2003年TG4全爱尔兰高级女子盖尔式足球锦标赛决赛由梅奥队对阵都柏林队。梅奥队在低比分的比赛中击败都柏林队，成功卫冕，并在5年内第4次夺冠；都柏林队则是首次参加决赛。半场结束时，都柏林队以0比4对0比2领先。终场前两分钟，梅奥队仍落后1分，但本场最佳球员黛安·奥霍拉在最后时刻攻入一球，决定了比赛结果。

en.s: The eighth gubernatorial election for the city of Bangkok, Thailand, was held on 5 October 2008. The election was won by the incumbent Governor Apirak Kosayothin, placing him in his second consecutive four-year term in office, winning 45.93 percent of the vote. Of a total of 4,087,329 eligible voters, 2,214,320 voted, giving a turnout rate of 54.18 percent, lower than the 70 percent target expected by the Election Committee. Sixteen candidates contested the election. Mr Apirak, candidate for the opposition Democrat Party, was seen as the favourite.

zh.s: 泰国曼谷于2008年10月5日举行第八次市长选举。现任市长阿披叻·哥沙育获胜，开始连续第二个4年任期，得票率为45.93%。4087329名合资格选民中有2214320人投票，投票率为54.18%，低于选举委员会预期的70%。共有16名候选人参选。反对党民主党候选人阿披叻被视为热门人选。

en.s: No Mercy (2008) was a professional wrestling pay-per-view event produced by World Wrestling Entertainment (WWE), which took place on October 5, 2008, at the Rose Garden in Portland, Oregon. It was the eleventh No Mercy event and starred wrestlers from the Raw, SmackDown and ECW brands. It is one of only two WWE pay-per-view events to be held in the state of Oregon, the other being Unforgiven 2004. Eight professional wrestling matches were scheduled on the event's card, which featured a supercard, a scheduling of more than one main event.

zh.s: 《无情》（2008）是世界摔角娱乐（WWE）举办的一场职业摔角付费电视赛事，于2008年10月5日在俄勒冈州波特兰的玫瑰园体育馆举行。这是第11届《无情》赛事，参赛者来自Raw、SmackDown和ECW三个品牌。这也是仅有的两场在俄勒冈州举办的WWE付费电视赛事之一，另一场是2004年的《不可饶恕》。赛事安排了8场职业摔角比赛，采用“超级赛事”形式，也就是设置多场主赛。

en.s: Municipal elections were held in Bosnia and Herzegovina on 5 October 2008. Parties and independent candidates had to register by 23 May 2008, party or coalition lists by 25 June 2008. These were the first local elections were representatives of minorities were elected to the municipal assemblies. 64 political parties and 183 independent candidates were certified to stand in the election. Nationalist parties (the Party of Democratic Action and the Croatian Democratic Union of Bosnia and Herzegovina in the federation and the Alliance of Independent Social Democrats in the RS) were the most successful in the election, while the Party for Bosnia and Herzegovina was considered to have been the loser of the election.

zh.s: 2008年10月5日，波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那举行市政选举。政党和独立候选人必须在2008年5月23日前登记，政党或联盟名单则须在6月25日前登记。这是首次在地方选举中选出少数族裔代表进入市议会。共有64个政党和183名独立候选人获准参选。民族主义政党在选举中表现最好，包括联邦内的民主行动党、波黑克罗地亚族民主联盟，以及塞族共和国的独立社会民主人士联盟；波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那党则被认为是输家。

en.s: The 2008 São Paulo municipal election took place in the city of São Paulo, with the first round taking place on 5 October and the second round taking place on 26 October 2008. Voters voted to elect the Mayor, the Vice Mayor, and 55 City Councillors for the administration of the city.

zh.s: 2008年圣保罗市政选举在圣保罗市举行。首轮投票于10月5日举行，第二轮于2008年10月26日举行。选民选出市长、副市长和55名市议员，组成该市的政府。

en.s: The 2010 Lamar Hunt U.S. Open Cup final was played on October 5, 2010, at Qwest Field (since renamed CenturyLink Field) in Seattle, Washington, United States. The match determined the winner of the 2010 U.S. Open Cup, a tournament open to amateur and professional soccer teams affiliated with the United States Soccer Federation. This was the 97th edition of the oldest competition in United States soccer.

zh.s: 2010年拉马尔·亨特美国公开杯决赛于2010年10月5日在美国华盛顿州西雅图的奎斯特球场（后改名为世纪互联球场）举行。比赛决出2010年美国公开杯冠军；该赛事向隶属美国足球联合会的业余和职业足球队开放。这是美国足球历史最悠久的持续举办赛事的第97届。

en.s: The Mekong River massacre occurred on the morning of 5 October 2011, when two Chinese cargo ships were attacked on a stretch of the Mekong River in the Golden Triangle region on the borders of Myanmar (Burma) and Thailand. All 13 crew members on both ships were killed and dumped in the river. It was the deadliest attack on Chinese nationals abroad in modern times.

zh.s: 2011年10月5日上午，两艘中国货船在缅甸与泰国边境金三角地区的一段湄公河水域遭到袭击，史称湄公河惨案。两船13名船员全部遇害，尸体被抛入河中。这是现代史上中国公民在海外遭遇的伤亡最惨重的袭击事件。

en.t: UFC on FX: Browne vs. Bigfoot
en.s: UFC on FX: Browne vs. Bigfoot (also known as UFC on FX 5) was a mixed martial arts event held by the Ultimate Fighting Championship on October 5, 2012 at the Target Center in Minneapolis, Minnesota. It was the fifth UFC event broadcast live on FX.

zh.t: UFC FX赛事：布朗对阵大脚席尔瓦
zh.s: UFC FX赛事：布朗对阵大脚席尔瓦，又称UFC FX 5，是终极格斗冠军赛于2012年10月5日在明尼苏达州明尼阿波利斯的塔吉特中心举办的一场综合格斗赛事。这是首次通过FX频道现场直播的第5场UFC赛事。

en.s: On October 5, 2013, U.S. Navy SEALs carried out a raid in Barawe, Somalia, targeting an al-Shabaab leader. The force withdrew without capturing its target.

zh.t: 美国海豹突击队突袭巴拉韦
zh.s: 2013年10月5日，美国海豹突击队在索马里巴拉韦展开突袭，目标是一名青年党领导人。突击队未能抓获目标，随后撤离。

en.s: Operation Puttur was an counter-terrorism operation launched jointly by the Andhra Pradesh and Tamil Nadu Police, which resulted in the capture two extremists belonging to Al Ummah in Puttur on 5 October 2013. The militants were planning to plant bombs at the Tirumala Venkateswara Temple, and commit a murder in Chennai in the name of the "Muslim Defence Force".

zh.s: 普图尔行动是安得拉邦警方与泰米尔纳德邦警方联合发起的一次反恐行动，于2013年10月5日在普图尔抓获了两名属于“乌玛党”的极端分子。武装分子计划在蒂鲁马拉文卡特斯瓦拉神庙安放炸弹，并以“穆斯林防卫军”的名义在金奈杀人。

en.t: Flávio Dino wins Maranhão’s gubernatorial election in the first round
en.s: On October 5, 2014, Maranhão held its gubernatorial election. Flávio Dino of the Communist Party of Brazil won a majority and was elected in the first round.

zh.t: 弗拉维奥·迪诺首轮当选马拉尼昂州州长
zh.s: 2014年10月5日，巴西马拉尼昂州举行州长选举。巴西共产党候选人弗拉维奥·迪诺获得过半选票，在首轮投票中当选。

en.s: The Piauí gubernatorial election was held on 5 October 2014 to elect the next governor of the state of Piauí. Governor Moraes Souza Filho ran for his first full term after becoming governor in 2014, but was resoundingly defeated by Senator Wellington Dias of the PT in the first round.

zh.s: 2014年10月5日，皮奥伊州举行州长选举，选出下一任州长。现任州长莫赖斯·索萨·菲略竞选首个完整任期，但在首轮投票中以压倒性优势败给劳工党参议员韦灵顿·迪亚斯。

en.s: The Paraíba gubernatorial election was held on 5 October 2014 to elect the next governor of the state of Paraíba, Brazil. Governor Ricardo Coutinho of the Brazilian Socialist Party ran for reelection and won.

zh.s: 2014年10月5日，巴西帕拉伊巴州举行州长选举，选出下一任州长。巴西社会党籍现任州长里卡多·库蒂尼奥竞选连任并获胜。

en.t: 2014 Rio Grande do Sul gubernatorial election
en.s: The Rio Grande do Sul gubernatorial election was held on 5 October 2014 to elect the next governor of the state of Rio Grande do Sul. Since no candidate received more than 50% of the vote in the first round, a second-round runoff election was held on 26 October. Incumbent governor Tarso Genro was running for a second term, a distinction not achieved in recent history.

zh.t: 2014年南里奥格兰德州州长选举
zh.s: 2014年10月5日，南里奥格兰德州举行州长选举，选出下一任州长。首轮投票中没有候选人得票超过50%，因此10月26日举行决选。现任州长塔索·热诺寻求连任；在该州近年的历史上，州长成功连任的情况并不多见。

en.s: The Paraná gubernatorial election was held on 5 October 2014 to elect the next governor of the state of Paraná. Governor Beto Richa successfully ran for reelection, winning without the need for a runoff.

zh.s: 2014年10月5日，巴西巴拉那州举行州长选举，选出下一任州长。州长贝托·里沙成功连任，无需参加决选。

en.s: The Alagoas gubernatorial election was held on 5 October 2014 to elect the next governor of the state of Alagoas. If no candidate had received more than 50% of the vote, a second-round runoff election would have been held on 26 October. Governor Teotônio Vilela Filho was ineligible due to term limits. Federal Deputy Renan Filho of the PMDB won election to the open seat in the first round.

zh.s: 2014年10月5日，阿拉戈斯州举行州长选举，选出下一任州长。若无人得票超过50%，原定于10月26日举行决选。现任州长特奥托尼奥·维莱拉·菲略因任期限制不能竞选。巴西民主运动党（PMDB）联邦众议员雷南·菲略赢得空缺席位，在首轮投票中当选。

en.s: The Amapá gubernatorial election was held on 5 October 2014 to elect the next governor of the state of Amapá. Since no candidate received more than 50% of the vote, a second-round runoff election was held on 26 October. Governor Camilo Capiberibe ran for a second term and was forced into a runoff with former Governor Waldez Góes.

zh.s: 2014年10月5日，阿马帕州举行州长选举，选出下一任州长。由于没有候选人获得超过50%的选票，10月26日举行决选。现任州长卡米洛·卡皮贝里贝竞选连任，进入决选，对手是前州长瓦尔德斯·戈埃斯。

en.t: 2014 Rio Grande do Norte gubernatorial election
en.s: The Rio Grande do Norte gubernatorial election was held on 5 October 2014 to elect the governor of Rio Grande do Norte. Incumbent Governor Rosalba Ciarlini sought nomination for a second term, but her candidacy was vetoed by her party due to her low approval ratings. Robinson Faria was announced as the victor with 54,38% of the vote, who had been elected as Vice-Governor in 2010 alongside Governor Ciarlini.

zh.t: 2014年北里奥格兰德州州长选举
zh.s: 2014年10月5日，北里奥格兰德州举行州长选举。现任州长罗萨尔巴·恰尔利尼争取党内提名连任，但因支持率偏低被本党否决。罗宾逊·法里亚以54.38%的得票率获胜；2010年，他曾与恰尔利尼搭档当选副州长。

en.s: The Sergipe gubernatorial election was held on 5 October 2014 to elect the next governor of the state of Sergipe. If no candidate had received more than 50% of the vote, a second-round runoff election would have been held on 26 October. Governor Jackson Barreto ran for his first full term after assuming the Governorship in December 2013 and won in the first round.

zh.s: 2014年10月5日，塞尔希培州举行州长选举，选出下一任州长。若无人得票超过50%，原定于10月26日举行决选。杰克逊·巴雷托于2013年12月就任州长后，首次竞选完整任期，并在首轮投票中获胜。

en.s: The Mato Grosso gubernatorial election was held on 5 October 2014 to elect the next governor of the state of Mato Grosso. If no candidate had received more than 50% of the vote, a second-round runoff election would have been held on 26 October. Governor Silval Barbosa did not run for a second term. Senator Pedro Taques of the PDT won election to the open seat in the first round.

zh.s: 2014年10月5日，马托格罗索州举行州长选举，选出下一任州长。若无人得票超过50%，原定于10月26日举行决选。现任州长席尔瓦尔·巴博萨没有竞选连任。民主工党候选人、参议员佩德罗·塔克斯赢得空缺席位，在首轮投票中当选。

en.s: The Tocantins gubernatorial election was held on 5 October 2014 to elect the next governor of the state of Tocantins, Brazil. If no candidate had received more than 50% of the vote, a second-round runoff election would have been held on 26 October. Governor Sandoval Cardoso ran for his first full term after becoming governor in 2014, but lost to former Governor Marcelo Miranda in the first round.

zh.s: 2014年10月5日，巴西托坎廷斯州举行州长选举，选出下一任州长。若无人得票超过50%，原定于10月26日举行决选。现任州长桑多瓦尔·卡多索于2014年就任后，首次竞选完整任期，但在首轮投票中败给前州长马塞洛·米兰达。

en.s: The Espírito Santo gubernatorial election was held on 5 October 2014 to elect the Governor of the state of Espírito Santo. Governor Renato Casagrande lost a bid for a second term to former Governor Paulo Hartung.

zh.t: 2014年圣埃斯皮里图州州长选举
zh.s: 2014年10月5日，圣埃斯皮里图州举行州长选举。前州长保罗·阿通击败现任州长雷纳托·卡萨格兰德，使其无法连任第二个任期。

en.s: The Amazonas gubernatorial election was held on 5 October 2014 to elect the next governor of the state of Amazonas. If no candidate had received more than 50% of the vote, a second-round runoff election would've been held on 26 October. In the election Governor José Melo ran for his first full term after assuming the Governorship in April 2014, and he won.

zh.s: 2014年10月5日，亚马孙州举行州长选举，选出下一任州长。若无人得票超过50%，原定于10月26日举行决选。现任州长若泽·梅洛于2014年4月就任后，首次竞选完整任期并获胜。

en.s: The Rio de Janeiro gubernatorial election was held on 5 October 2014 to elect the next governor of the state of Rio de Janeiro. Since no candidate received more than 50% of the vote, a second-round runoff election was held on the 26th of October. Incumbent Governor Luiz Fernando Pezão, who was running for his first full term, was forced into the runoff against Marcelo Crivella but ultimately won.

zh.s: 2014年10月5日，里约热内卢州举行州长选举，选出下一任州长。由于无人得票超过50%，10月26日举行决选。首次竞选完整任期的现任州长路易斯·费尔南多·佩绍进入决选，对手是马塞洛·克里韦拉，最终获胜。

en.s: The Roraima gubernatorial election was held on 5 October 2014 to elect the next governor of the state of Roraima, Brazil. Governor Chico Rodrigues ran for his first full term after assuming the Governorship in April 2014.

zh.s: 2014年10月5日，巴西罗赖马州举行州长选举，选出下一任州长。奇科·罗德里格斯于2014年4月就任州长后，首次竞选完整任期。

en.s: The Santa Catarina gubernatorial election was held on 5 October 2014 to elect the next governor of the state of Santa Catarina. Governor Raimundo Colombo was re-elected to a second term.

zh.s: 2014年10月5日，圣卡塔琳娜州举行州长选举，现任州长拉伊蒙多·科伦坡再次当选，开始第二个任期。

en.s: The first round of the Acre gubernatorial election was held on 5 October 2014 to elect the next governor of the state of Acre. No candidate won 50% of the vote and thus a second-round runoff election was held on 26 October. Governor Tião Viana was re-elected for a second term.

zh.s: 2014年10月5日，阿克里州州长选举举行首轮投票，选出下一任州长。没有候选人获得50%的选票，因此10月26日举行决选。蒂昂·维亚纳成功连任，开始第二个任期。

en.s: The São Paulo gubernatorial election was held on 5 October 2014 to elect the next governor of the state of São Paulo. If no candidate had received more than 50% of the vote, a second-round runoff election would have been held on 26 October. Incumbent Governor Geraldo Alckmin won re-election in the first round.

zh.s: 2014年10月5日，圣保罗州举行州长选举，选出下一任州长。若无人得票超过50%，原定于10月26日举行决选。现任州长杰拉尔多·阿尔克明在首轮投票中连任。

en.s: The Pará gubernatorial election was held on 5 October 2014 to elect the next governor of the state of Pará.

en.s: One Shot (2017) was a professional wrestling supercard event produced by Major League Wrestling (MLW), which took place on October 5, 2017, at the Gilt Nightclub in Orlando, Florida. This was the first event under the One Shot chronology and MLW's first event since 2004. Nine professional wrestling matches were contested at the event. In the main event, Shane Strickland defeated Ricochet.

zh.s: 《一击》（2017）是美国职业摔角联盟（MLW）举办的一场职业摔角超级赛事，于2017年10月5日在佛罗里达州奥兰多的吉尔特夜总会举行。这是“一击”系列的首场赛事，也是MLW自2004年以来首次举办赛事。全场共进行了9场比赛。主赛中，沙恩·斯特里克兰击败里科歇。

en.t: Armed men attack police stations in Mocímboa da Praia
en.s: On October 5, 2017, armed men attacked three police stations in Mocímboa da Praia, in Mozambique’s Cabo Delgado Province.

zh.t: 武装人员袭击莫辛布瓦达普拉亚的警察机构
zh.s: 2017年10月5日，武装人员袭击莫桑比克德尔加杜角省莫辛布瓦达普拉亚的三处警察机构。

en.s: The PFL 8 mixed martial arts event for the 2018 season of the Professional Fighters League was held on October 5, 2018, at the Ernest N. Morial Convention Center in New Orleans, Louisiana.

zh.s: 职业格斗联盟2018赛季的PFL 8综合格斗赛事于2018年10月5日在路易斯安那州新奥尔良的欧内斯特·N·莫里尔会议中心举行。

en.s: The CMLL International Gran Prix (2018) is a lucha libre, or professional wrestling, tournament produced and scripted by the Mexican professional wrestling promotion Consejo Mundial de Lucha Libre (CMLL; "World Wrestling Council" in Spanish) which took place on October 5, 2018 in Arena México, Mexico City, Mexico, CMLL's main venue. The 2018 International Gran Prix was the fourteenth time CMLL held an International Gran Prix tournament since 1994.

zh.s: 2018年CMLL国际大奖赛是墨西哥摔角推广组织墨西哥摔角理事会（CMLL）举办并编排的一场自由式摔角（即职业摔角）锦标赛，于2018年10月5日在该组织的主场——墨西哥城墨西哥竞技场举行。这是CMLL自1994年以来第14次举办国际大奖赛。

en.s: The 2019 National Premier Leagues Grand Final was the seventh National Premier Leagues Grand Final, the championship deciding match of the National Premier Leagues in Australia. It was played on 5 October 2019 at Albert Butler Park in Wollongong between Wollongong Wolves and Lions FC. Wollongong won the match 4–3 to secure their first championship in the National Premier Leagues.

zh.t: 2019年澳大利亚全国超级联赛总决赛
zh.s: 2019年澳大利亚全国超级联赛总决赛是该联赛的第7届冠军决胜赛，于2019年10月5日在卧龙岗的阿尔伯特·巴特勒公园举行，由卧龙岗狼队对阵狮子足球俱乐部。卧龙岗狼队以4比3获胜，首次夺得全国超级联赛冠军。

en.t: MLW and The Crash hold a joint wrestling show in Tijuana
en.s: On October 5, 2019, Major League Wrestling and The Crash held a joint professional wrestling show in Tijuana, Mexico. Matches were recorded for later episodes of MLW Fusion.
en.n: The television broadcasts followed the live show.

zh.t: MLW与The Crash在蒂华纳合办摔角赛事
zh.s: 2019年10月5日，MLW与The Crash在墨西哥蒂华纳合办职业摔角赛事，并录制比赛，供《MLW Fusion》之后播出。
zh.n: 电视节目在现场赛事结束后播出。

en.t: 2021 New South Wales Liberal Party leadership election
en.s: The 2021 Liberal Party of Australia (New South Wales Division) leadership election was a leadership vote held on 5 October 2021 to elect a new leader of the New South Wales Division of the Liberal Party of Australia and subsequently the Premier of New South Wales, following the resignation of Gladys Berejiklian. The election was conducted among the Liberal Party members of the Parliament of New South Wales and contested between Dominic Perrottet and Rob Stokes.

zh.t: 2021年新南威尔士州自由党党魁选举
zh.s: 2021年10月5日，澳大利亚自由党新南威尔士州分部举行党魁选举，选出新任党魁，并由其接任新南威尔士州州长。此前，格拉迪丝·贝雷吉克利安辞职。选举由新南威尔士州议会中的自由党议员投票，候选人为多米尼克·佩罗泰特和罗布·斯托克斯。

en.s: The 27th Busan International Film Festival (Korean: 제27회 부산국제영화제) was held from October 5 at the Busan Cinema Center in Busan, South Korea till October 14. This year, the festival restarted events and program sections which were not conducted due to COVID-19 for last 2 years. The festival opened with Iranian film Scent of the Wind by director Seyed Hadi Mohaghegh, Jeon Yeo-been with Ryu Jun-yeol were master of ceremonies for the opening ceremony.
en.n: This entry records the opening, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.s: 第27届釜山国际电影节（韩语：제27회 부산국제영화제）于10月5日至14日在釜山电影中心举行。本届电影节恢复了此前两年因新冠疫情停办的活动和单元。开幕影片是伊朗导演赛义德·哈迪·穆哈格赫执导的《风的气息》，全汝彬和柳俊烈担任开幕式主持人。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的开幕日期。

en.s: A by-election for the United Kingdom parliamentary constituency of Rutherglen and Hamilton West was held on 5 October 2023, following the recall of incumbent Scottish National Party (SNP) MP Margaret Ferrier. The by-election was won by Michael Shanks of the Labour Party with a large swing of 20.4%. Ferrier, elected for the SNP, was suspended from her party in October 2020 after it emerged she had significantly breached COVID-19 restrictions.

zh.t: 2023年拉瑟格伦和汉密尔顿西选区补选
zh.s: 2023年10月5日，英国议会拉瑟格伦和汉密尔顿西选区举行补选，原因是苏格兰民族党议员玛格丽特·费里尔被罢免。工党候选人迈克尔·尚克斯以大幅得票转移赢得补选。费里尔于2020年10月因严重违反新冠防疫规定而遭党内停职。

en.s: The 2023 Memphis mayoral election took place on October 5, 2023, to elect the next mayor of Memphis, Tennessee. Incumbent Jim Strickland was term-limited and could not seek re-election to a third term in office. The election used the plurality vote system, with no possibility of a runoff. The election was officially non-partisan, but several candidates were affiliated with political parties.

zh.s: 2023年10月5日，田纳西州孟菲斯举行市长选举，选出下一任市长。现任市长吉姆·斯特里克兰受任期限制，不能竞选第三个任期。选举采用相对多数制，不设决选。选举正式上不设党派，但有多名候选人与政党有关联。

en.s: UFC 307: Pereira vs. Rountree Jr. was a mixed martial arts event produced by the Ultimate Fighting Championship that took place on October 5, 2024, at the Delta Center in Salt Lake City, Utah, United States.

zh.s: UFC 307（佩雷拉对阵朗特里二世）是终极格斗冠军赛举办的一场综合格斗赛事，于2024年10月5日在美国犹他州盐湖城的三角洲中心举行。

en.s: An election for the leader of Social Democracy (SOCDEM) was held on 5 October 2024 due to the resignation of the incumbent Michal Šmarda.

zh.t: 2024年社会民主党（捷克）党魁选举
zh.s: 2024年10月5日，捷克社会民主党（SOCDEM）举行党魁选举，原因是现任党魁米哈尔·什马尔达辞职。

en.s: 2024 Haryana Legislative Assembly election was held on 5 October 2024 to elect all 90 members of the Haryana Legislative Assembly. The schedule of the election was announced by the Election Commission of India on 16 August 2024. The ballots were counted and the results were declared on 8 October 2024.

zh.t: 2024年哈里亚纳邦立法议会选举
zh.s: 2024年10月5日，哈里亚纳邦举行立法议会选举，选出全部90名议员。印度选举委员会于2024年8月16日公布选举日程。选票于10月8日统计，结果也在当天公布。

en.s: Progress x Noah x DEFY was a professional wrestling event co-promoted by Progress Wrestling, Pro Wrestling Noah and DEFY Wrestling. It took place on October 5, 2024, in Oberhausen, Germany at the Turbinenhalle Oberhausen. The event also featured wrestlers from Westside Xtreme Wrestling (wXw). Six matches were contested at the event. The main event saw Luke Jacobs defeat Timothy Thatcher to retain the PROGRESS World Championship.

zh.s: Progress、职业摔角NOAH和DEFY Wrestling联合举办了这场职业摔角赛事。赛事于2024年10月5日在德国奥伯豪森的奥伯豪森涡轮大厅举行，wXw选手也参加了比赛。全场共进行了6场比赛。主赛中，卢克·雅各布斯击败蒂莫西·撒切尔，成功卫冕PROGRESS世界冠军。

en.s: The 2024 Bad Blood, also promoted as Bad Blood: Atlanta, was a professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) and livestreaming event produced by WWE, held for wrestlers from the promotion's main roster brands, Raw and SmackDown. It was the fourth Bad Blood and took place on October 5, 2024, at the State Farm Arena in Atlanta, Georgia, which was the 27-year anniversary of the first event that also featured the first Hell in a Cell match.

zh.s: 2024年《血战》又以《血战：亚特兰大》为宣传名，是WWE举办的职业摔角付费电视和线上直播赛事，参赛者来自Raw和SmackDown两个主阵容品牌。这是第4届《血战》赛事，于2024年10月5日在佐治亚州亚特兰大的州立农场体育馆举行。比赛日期恰逢首届赛事27周年；首届赛事中也进行了第一场地狱牢笼赛。

en.s: The 2024 Uzbekistan Cup final (in Uzbek: Футбол бўйича 2024-йилги Ўзбекистон Кубоги финали) was the 32nd final of the Uzbekistan Cup. The match was played on 5 October 2024, Saturday, at the "Istiqlol" Stadium in Fergana to determine the winner of 2024 Uzbekistan Cup. The match ended with Andijan's 3–2 victory over Navbahor.

zh.s: 2024年乌兹别克斯坦杯决赛（乌兹别克语：Футбол бўйича 2024-йилги Ўзбекистон Кубоги финали）是该项赛事第32届决赛。比赛于2024年10月5日（星期六）在费尔干纳的伊斯蒂克洛尔体育场举行，决出2024年乌兹别克斯坦杯冠军。安集延队以3比2获胜，击败纳夫巴霍尔队夺冠。

en.s: The siege of North Gaza was an engagement of the Gaza war in the North Gaza Governorate, Gaza Strip, between Israel and Hamas-led Palestinian forces. It began on 5 October 2024 when the Israel Defense Forces (IDF) reinvaded Jabalia and its refugee camp for the first time in months since earlier fighting.

zh.s: 加沙北部围困是加沙战争期间以色列与哈马斯领导的巴勒斯坦武装在加沙地带北加沙省发生的交战。2024年10月5日，以色列国防军再次进入贾巴利亚及其难民营，数月来首次在当地展开战斗，围困由此开始。

en.t: 2024 Social Democratic and Labour Party leadership election
en.s: A leadership election was held for the Social Democratic and Labour Party (SDLP) of Northern Ireland on 5 October 2024, following the resignation of Colum Eastwood on 29 August 2024 to focus on his role in the party's New Ireland Commission and as Member of Parliament (MP) for Foyle. The SDLP's other MP, Claire Hanna, ran unopposed for the leadership.

zh.t: 2024年社会民主与劳工党党魁选举

en.s: The 2026 Quebec general election was held on October 5, 2026, to elect members to the National Assembly of the 44th Quebec Legislature. Lieutenant Governor Manon Jeannotte dropped the writs of election on August 27, 2026, after Premier Christine Fréchette advised her to dissolve the legislature. Key issues of the election campaign included the cost of living, housing, Quebec sovereignty, infrastructure, protection of Quebec culture and the French language, U.S. tariffs, healthcare, the economy, and energy.
